config:
[apps]
quit=["Quit Demo"]
freeze=["Freeze Demo"]
skip=["Skip Demo"]
ask=["Ask Demo"]
default="skip"
[[apps.with_daemon]]
name="Remote Demo"
group="network"
system_daemons=["<ROOT>/org.demo.daemon.plist"]
[network]
apps=["Network Demo", "Remote Demo"]
[services]
unload=["org.demo.worker"]
[options]
language="en"
labels: [green]✔ Ask Demo frozen (1 processes; off resumes them)[/]
log: Ask Demo frozen (1 processes stopped; off resumes them with CONT)

power_origin.ac_prof: lowpowermode 0 sleep 0 displaysleep 0 powernap 1 tcpkeepalive 1 womp 1 standby 1 hibernatemode 3 ttyskeepawake 1 disksleep 10 networkoversleep 0
power_origin.batt_prof: lowpowermode 0 sleep 1 displaysleep 10 powernap 0 tcpkeepalive 1 womp 0 standby 1 hibernatemode 3 ttyskeepawake 1 disksleep 10 lessbright 1 networkoversleep 0
